evidence.title: SK Hynix maintains HBM market leadership with 50% share in 2026
evidence.summary: TrendForce (2025-09-17): SK hynix forecast to retain OVER 50% of global HBM bit output in 2026. Scope: bit-output share. NOTE: precise 50/59/28 trajectory in an earlier draft was NOT on the page and was removed at verification.
evidence.excerpt: SK hynix is forecast to retain over 50% share and lead the market.

evidence.title: Samsung HBM production capacity expansion to 250k wafers/month by end 2026
evidence.summary: Samsung HBM production capacity: ~250k wafers/month by end 2026 (47% increase from 170k wafers). Current capacity 170k wafers/month as baseline. Source basis: wafer-level production capacity, not finished units.
evidence.excerpt: Samsung aims to boost HBM production to around 250,000 wafers per month by the end of 2026—a roughly 47% increase from the current 170,000 wafers.

evidence.title: Micron HBM4 production ramp Q2 2026 with 15k wafers/month target
evidence.summary: TrendForce (2025-12-18): Micron's entire calendar-2026 HBM supply is pre-sold (pricing+volume locked), HBM4 ramps 2Q26. The '15,000 wafers/month' figure in an earlier draft was NOT on the page and was removed at verification.
evidence.excerpt: Micron has already locked in pricing and volume agreements covering its entire calendar 2026 HBM supply, including HBM4.

evidence.title: HBM total market capacity exceeds 30 billion Gb in 2026
evidence.summary: HBM total market capacity 2026: >30 billion Gb bits across all suppliers (SK Hynix, Samsung, Micron). Source basis: total bit capacity shipment forecast, not unit capacity or wafers.
evidence.excerpt: TrendForce projects HBM shipments will surpass 30 billion Gb by 2026.

evidence.title: SK Hynix M15X Cheongju fab ramping 40k wafers/month by 2H 2026
evidence.summary: SK Hynix M15X fab in Cheongju: initial output 10k wafers/month with expansion planned. Latest guidance indicates 40k wafers/month capacity by 2H 2026. Source basis: fab-level wafer capacity.
evidence.excerpt: SK hynix plans to start 1b DRAM production for the latest HBM4 at M15X in February, with initial output expected at ~10,000 wafers per month, with capacity set to expand multiple times by the end of 2026.

evidence.title: SK Hynix completes 12-high hybrid bonding HBM validation, yields improving

evidence.excerpt: SK hynix has reportedly completed 12-high hybrid bonding HBM validation, working to raise yields for mass production.

evidence.title: Advantest ATE test equipment lead times exceed 6 months in 2026 for HBM

evidence.excerpt: System sales in units: 48 EUV lithography systems (of 535 total systems sold in 2025).

evidence.title: ASML Market Leadership in Lithography Equipment
evidence.summary: Tertiary source (Wikipedia, fetched 2026-06-11): ~83% of worldwide lithography-equipment sales. Treat as approximate; primary scoped source still wanted.
evidence.excerpt: As of 2025, ASML had 83 percent of the worldwide sales of lithography machines.

evidence.title: ASML Monopoly Position in EUV Lithography
evidence.summary: ASML is the only company that produces and sells EUV systems for chip production as of 2025. This monopoly resulted from ASML's 2001 acquisition of SVG, which provided access to critical EUV technology. Geopolitical consequences: US and Dutch export controls restrict ASML sales to China.
evidence.excerpt: ASML...is the only company that produces and sells EUV systems for chip production [as of 2025]. Reuters reported in December 2025 that China had developed its own prototype EUV system.

evidence.title: Carl Zeiss SMT: Sole Supplier of EUV Projection Optics
evidence.summary: Carl Zeiss (Zeiss Group, Germany) produces the EUV projection optics for ASML systems. Zeiss manufactures the most precise mirrors in the world, using ion beam figuring techniques to remove atomic-scale defects from multilayer Mo/Ru stacks. Optics are bounced onto wafers to form chip designs. Zeiss is the sole global supplier of these critical optical subsystems.
evidence.excerpt: The light is bounced off Zeiss mirrors onto the surface of a silicon wafer to form the designs for the chip...Germany's Carl Zeiss [works with ASML]. Zeiss produces the most precise mirrors in the world [via] ion beam figuring [to knock off] individual molecules [to correct imperfections].

evidence.title: ASML and Carl Zeiss SMT Strategic Partnership for Next-Generation EUV Optics
evidence.summary: ASML and Carl Zeiss SMT strengthened their strategic partnership through equity investment and multi-year R&D commitment. ASML purchased 24.9% minority stake in Zeiss SMT for €1 billion and committed approximately €760 million over six years to support Zeiss SMT's research, development, and capital expenditures. Partnership aims to develop next-generation High-NA EUV optical systems (NA > 0.5 vs current 0.33 NA) for further chip scaling toward sub-3nm nodes. Partnership described as 30-year long-standing collaboration with Zeiss as ASML's most important strategic partner.
evidence.excerpt: ASML buys 24.9% of ZEISS subsidiary Carl Zeiss SMT for EUR 1 billion in cash... ASML supports Carl Zeiss SMT's R&D and capex for approximately EUR 760 million over the next 6 years (EUR 220M R&D + EUR 540M capex/supply-chain).

evidence.title: Hoya Expands EUV Photomask Blank Capabilities for High-NA Systems
evidence.excerpt: HOYA has unveiled new advancements in EUV photomask blanks... one of the few capable players in this highly specialized domain.
evidence.summary: semiconductorinsight.com blog: Hoya described as ONE OF THE FEW capable players. The page does NOT say 'only vendor with validated High-NA blanks' (an earlier draft's quote was fabricated; removed at verification). No supporting citations on page.
evidence.limitations: Blog/news aggregator source. Claim of single-source qualification stated without citation to official ASML lists or foundry announcements. ASML High-NA product pages do not name suppliers. Appears to be inference from Hoya announcements rather than documented qualification.

evidence.title: High-NA EUV Mask Blank Qualification Status: Unverified
evidence.summary: Prior graph claimed Hoya 100% exclusive/only qualified supplier for High-NA blanks. Rebuild research found: (1) ASML High-NA pages do not list qualified blank suppliers; (2) no Hoya investor docs or ASML qualification matrix accessed; (3) no customer announcement naming exclusive Hoya sourcing found; (4) imec's March 2026 High-NA demo made no mention of supply constraints or exclusive sourcing. Single-source claim lacks verification. Recommendation: downgrade to 'Hoya reported furthest along; qualification status unconfirmed.'
evidence.limitations: Inaccessible primary sources: Hoya annual report, ASML qualification docs, Intel/Samsung/TSMC supply statements. Without these, the 100% claim cannot be validated. Assessment: plausible but unverified.
